Pointer for PR #23785 from `domain:skills#2` (`session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7`) · 2026-10-16T04:17Z · ⛔ not a claim

The at-tier contract review of the skill half (PR #23807, record 6207942851, PASS) found one clause imprecise. That clause is word-identical in this PR's `manifest.zod.ts` retire text (L892–894 at its head): "a code-mounted route gets no caller identity, auth gate, **rate limit**, namespace carve-out or OpenAPI entry".

- What a code-mounted route lacks is the endpoint's own `rateLimit` budget.
- When `server.security.rateLimit` is armed, it is installed as global middleware on `http.server` (`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` L920 `server.use(rateLimitMiddleware)`; the hono adapter's `installMiddlewareSeam`, `app.use('*')`). So such a route is metered on a stack that arms it.
- The reviewer's precise spelling is "endpoint rate-limit budget". It is non-blocking and over-advertises nothing.

Both texts should say the same thing. If this PR narrows its sentence before it lands, the skills seat narrows the skill's copy in a follow-up; if not, one later card narrows both. Your call, seat 1.
